pick.title: Select Enterprise
pick.subtitle: Choose an enterprise to manage governance.
pick.empty: No enterprises available for your identity.

dashboard.title: Enterprise Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Governance aggregates across organizations in this enterprise.
dashboard.read_model_note: Counts reflect governance metadata only — not wallet, payment, or settlement data.
dashboard.enterprise_required: Select an enterprise using the sidebar switcher or pick page.
dashboard.trend_empty: No creations in the recent window.

organizations.title: Organization Directory
organizations.subtitle: Organizations attached to this enterprise. Directory access does not grant merchant operations.
organizations.directory_note: Switch opens the Merchant Portal when you have organization membership. No login is recorded on switch.
organizations.empty_admin_hint: No organizations under this enterprise yet. Create one (for example a legal entity).
organizations.empty_viewer_hint: No organizations under this enterprise yet. Creating organizations requires Enterprise ADMIN.
organizations.field_owner_email_extra: Optional. User must have signed in to the merchant portal at least once.
organizations.switch_membership_required: You need active organization membership to open this organization in the Merchant Portal.
organizations.switch_suspended: This organization is suspended. Activate it before switching to the Merchant Portal.

audit.title: Enterprise Audit
audit.subtitle: Governance events for this enterprise. Ops platform audits are not shown here.

members.title: Enterprise Members
members.subtitle: Manage enterprise governance membership (not organization RBAC).
members.last_admin_required: Cannot remove or demote the last active enterprise admin.
